mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both series decline by at least 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 22900), the economy is approaching peak growth, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 22900.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a monetary policy response to inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both series rise by at least 0.5% in the prior month.
